rulings.restated: Add household helper "Number of people on the return (you, and your spouse if filing jointly)" and helper "Dependents you claim".
rulings.model: The restatement counts every person on the return, but the instructions drop anyone who can be claimed as a dependent: "If you checked the 'Someone can claim you as a dependent' box, or if you are filing jointly and you checked the 'Someone can claim your spouse as a dependent' box ... you or your spouse is not included in the tax family size calculation". No refusal covers this case.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; screen sa.dependent (root S2 of round 1, re-checked against the current data). i8962 p. 8, Line 1, "If you checked the “Someone can claim you as a dependent” box, or if you are filing jointly and you checked the “Someone can claim your spouse as a dependent” box on your tax return, you or your spouse is not included in the tax family size calculation". A return on which you or your spouse can be claimed is never completed: sa.dependent ("Can someone claim you or your spouse as a dependent for 2025 ...", forms/2025/sa.yaml) refuses f1040.line12e on every return (fixture stage8.single.filer_is_dependent), and D1 keeps the claimable filer refused. On the returns computed nobody on the return can be claimed, so everyone on it is in the tax family, as the restatement says. Re-checked for round 3: the rendered line and its gate are unchanged by the completion of BUG-0191 (line 1 stays on f8962.any, before the line 5 STOP). Re-checked this round: sa.dependent (forms/2025/sa.yaml) still refuses (when: sa.dependent); the reviewer's sentence is the one quoted, and no refusal is missing.

rulings.model: The applicable-taxpayer test uses only line 5 and the Marketplace-estimate exception. It ignores the married-filing-separately bar: "If you are not an applicable taxpayer because you are using filing status married filing separately and Exception 2, earlier, does not apply to you ... enter -0- on line 24". No refusal covers MFS.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; screen s3.mfs (root S1). f8962 p. 1, item A, "You cannot take the PTC if your filing status is married filing separately unless you qualify for an exception"; i8962 p. 16, Not an applicable taxpayer, "If you are not an applicable taxpayer because you are using filing status married filing separately and Exception 2, earlier, does not apply to you, you cannot take the PTC ... enter -0- on line 24". No married filing separately return is completed: scope.ready refuses on s3.mfs (forms/2025/s3.yaml, scope.yaml, cite i1040gi p. 14), Exception 2 included, as D1 keeps; as before. The reviewer does not raise the new display gate: line 24 is now shown only when f8962.filing (a Form 1095-A, and an applicable taxpayer or advance payments), which follows i8962 p. 10, "However, if no APTC was paid for any individuals in your tax family, stop; do not complete Form 8962"; its value is computed as before the gate (BUG-0191: values unchanged; stage18.married_in_2025_single evaluates to line 24 $3,560). The alien branch stays refused by f8962.alien_branch (stage18.refuse.alien_below_100). Re-checked this round: stage18.married_in_2025_single with f1040.status set to mfs (constructed by the adjudicator from the fixture, not a fixture) evaluates to a refusal at scope.ready and Form 1040 line 37 with gate s3.mfs. The R5 fix (f8962.excess reads f8962.filing) does not touch line 24.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; screen sc.hi_screen through sc.hi_screened (root S5 of round 1). i8962 p. 18, Line 28, "If you are self-employed and are claiming the self-employed health insurance deduction, see Self-Employed Health Insurance Deduction and PTC in Pub. 974 for the amount to enter on line 28." sc.hi_screen ("the insurance was obtained through the Marketplace and advance payments of the premium tax credit were made or you are claiming the premium tax credit ...") refuses through sc.hi_screened (forms/2025/sc.yaml; i1040gi p. 95, Exceptions). A self-employed health insurance deduction from a partnership, S corporation or farm is refused by scope.schedule1. D1 keeps "the self-employed health insurance deduction with a Marketplace plan" refused. The Table 5 amounts and the blank line at 400 or more match, as the reviewer says (Rev. Proc. 2024-40 §3.07; i8962 p. 18). Re-checked this round: sc.hi_screened is still a refusal (forms/2025/sc.yaml, when: sc.hi_screened). The R5 fix changes only the display of line 28 (f8962.show_28 reads f8962.excess, now false without a Form 1095-A); the bands are unchanged.

rulings.restated: Add dependent.ptc_magi_counted over every confirmed dependent entry for which helper "Your dependent" = true, within the current person when parent-bound. An unanswered roster is unknown.
rulings.model: It adds only the MAGI of dependents required to file. It leaves out the Form 8814 rule: "If you are filing Form 8814 ... and the amount on Form 8814, line 4, is more than $1,350, you must include on line 1 of Worksheet 1-2 the sum of the tax-exempt interest from Form 8814, line 1b; the lesser of Form 8814, line 4 or line 5; and any nontaxable social security benefits your child received". No refusal covers Form 8814.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; screen scope.other_line16 (root S3 of round 1). i8962 p. 8, Line 2b, "Form 8814. If you are filing Form 8814, Parents’ Election To Report Child’s Interest and Dividends, and the amount on Form 8814, line 4, is more than $1,350, you must include on line 1 of Worksheet 1-2 the sum of ...". The omitted rule concerns a child's income reported on the parent's return, which is Form 8814. scope.other_line16 ("Any additional Form 1040 line 16 tax or filing, including filing Form 8814 (even with no tax) ...") refuses every such return at scope.ready and at f1040.line16 (forms/2025/scope.yaml, f1040.yaml), and D1 keeps Form 8814 refused. The rest of the restatement (dependents required to file because of their income, through dependent.ptc_magi_counted, D7(b)) matches the line, as the reviewer says. Re-checked for round 3: unchanged by f8962.filing (line 2b stays on f8962.any). Re-checked this round: scope.other_line16 is still a refusal of scope.ready (forms/2025/scope.yaml).
